claims.claim: The personal-import duty-free threshold is $75 USD as of June 2, 2026. The Knesset revoked the order that had raised it; a transitional $130 cap applied 25 Feb - 1 Jun 2026, and the proposed $150 increase was rejected.
claims.raw_snippet: (Yonatan Sindel/Flash90) Knesset lawmakers on Tuesday voted 59-23 to revoke Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich’s order raising the value-added tax exemption threshold on personal imports from $75 to $130, effectively restoring the previous $75 limit. “All those who voted this evening against raising the VAT exemption on products ordered from overseas are hurting the pockets of Israeli citizens,” Smotrich wrote on X in response.

claims.claim: On a remote-sale cancellation the seller may charge a cancellation fee of 5% of the value of the product or service, or NIS 100, whichever is lower. On a cancellation for a reason other than a defect the consumer returns the product at their own expense.

claims.claim: Under the Consumer Protection (Cancellation of Transaction) Regulations a consumer may cancel an in-store consumer transaction unilaterally without giving a reason where the value of the product purchased exceeds NIS 50. Returning the product in its original packaging counts as proof it was not used, but opening the packaging is not itself use or damage unless proven otherwise. The seller may charge a cancellation fee of 5% of the price or NIS 100, whichever is lower, and must refund within 7 business days.

Under the Consumer Protection (Warranty and After-Sale Service) Regulations 2006, new electrical, electronic and gas products priced above 150 NIS (and mechanical mechanisms in furniture, and water heaters) carry a warranty of one year from actual delivery to the consumer; the manufacturer/importer must repair faults free of charge during that first year.
claims.raw_snippet: אחריות חלה על מוצרי חשמל, אלקטרוניקה וגז חדשים, שמחירם גבוה מ־150 ₪ וכן על מנגנונים מכניים בריהוט, ועל מחממי מים (דודי שמש / בוילרים). תקופת האחריות היא שנה מיום מסירת המוצר בפועל לצרכן.
